description: This file defines the RegistrationAPIClientService class responsible for interacting with an external registration API via HTTP POST requests, utilizing GuzzleHttp client. It includes methods to instantiate the client and publish data. It also uses a trait for logging and handles exceptions during API communication.

classes.name: RegistrationAPIClientService
classes.description: A service class for communicating with the registration API, handling client creation and data publishing.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Creates and returns the Guzzle HTTP client instance configured with the registration URL.

methods.name: publishData
methods.description: Sends data to the registration API via HTTP POST and returns true if successful, otherwise logs errors and returns false.
